note: Nebraska NF Pine Ridge unit adjacent to Soldier Creek Wilderness and Fort Robinson SP. From Crawford, US-20 to Fort Robinson then ~6 mi north on Soldier Creek Rd (gravel, with a paved creek crossing that can be dicey after heavy rain). Open grassland sites along the corral spur; general campground that also serves horse users (15-paddock corral, round pen, wilderness trailheads). Not inside the state park, so no state park permit is needed. --Claude
summary: Confirmed from the USFS page (Mar 2025) and rec.gov: 8 sites, hand-pump water, vault toilets, $15 (+$7.50 extra vehicle), FCFS walk-in only, interagency 50% discount; added season year_round and the forest's 14-day limit. Waterfront not waterfront kept; pin kept; inclusion OK (general campground with corrals, 'large enough to accommodate horse trailers or RVs').
flags: ROAD ALERT: the Nebraska NF lists 'Intermittent closure of USFS Road 7055' (road improvements) on this campground's page; the alert doesn't say whether 7055 is the Soldier Creek road. Check before a trip. No status change written.

PIN kept: stored 42.69540,-103.56890 is ~40 m SE of the campground's turnaround loop (~42.6957,-103.5692) and ~160 m from the parked-RV spur along the corrals (~42.6968,-103.5698). The USFS/rec.gov point (42.69889,-103.57639) is in the trees ~650 m WNW, so don't move it there. A small nudge to 42.69620,-103.56950 (between the loop and the corrals) would centre it; under the 250 m threshold.
WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: sites in open grassland on the corral spur; Soldier Creek's riparian tree line is 150 m+ away and the creek is a small stream.

INCLUSION: horse-oriented but not horse-only. USFS: '8 sites ... along with at least 3 other camping areas large enough for a horse trailer or RV'; rec.gov: 'large enough to accommodate horse trailers or RVs'. 6 mi gravel; no 4WD or clearance warning on either page. Don't confuse with Fort Robinson SP's own 'Soldier Creek Campground' (42.66305,-103.46648, Google 4.4 from 79, 308-665-2900), a different place.

PHONE 308-432-0300 confirmed (USFS and rec.gov). WEBSITE: the stored second line points at the Soldier Creek Wilderness page; the campground's own page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/nebraska/recreation/soldier-creek-campground (apply.py doesn't write website).
